$comment: Modifier groups from the Terraria Wiki's Modifiers page (checked Nov 2026): 16 melee, 12 ranged, 12 magic, 14 universal, 10 common, 19 accessory, 13 summon (1.4.5), plus 84, the Terrarian's own Legendary. classes says which groups each weapon class can roll; entries with since/until apply only to those save versions. A modifier ID in the synced data that is in no group gets a warning, not a block.

summon.$comment: Before 1.4.5 summon staffs rolled the magic pool. A real 1.4.4.9 save has staffs with Deadly (43) and Mythical (83).
1.4.5: summon set plus universal modifiers without crit. Loading the 1.4.4.9 save in 1.4.5.8 reset or rerolled exactly the staff modifiers outside this.
